keyVerseDR: "Watch ye therefore, because you know not the day nor the hour." (Mt 25:13)

level1.title: Keep Your Lamp Lit
level1.story: Ten bridesmaids waited for the bridegroom with lamps. Five brought extra oil, and five did not. Jesus says, "Be ready!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you be ready for Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, keep my lamp shining. Amen.

activity.title: Keep your lamp lit
activity.intro: Connect the dots to make a lamp full of oil.

level2.title: The Ten Virgins
level2.story: Jesus told a parable about ten virgins who took their lamps to meet the bridegroom. Five were foolish and took no extra oil, but five were wise and brought flasks of oil. The bridegroom was late, and they all fell asleep. At midnight came the cry, "Behold the bridegroom cometh!" While the foolish went to buy oil, the wise went in to the wedding, and the door was shut. Jesus said, "Watch ye therefore, because you know not the day nor the hour."
level2.keyLine: Watch ye, because you know not the day nor the hour.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What might the oil stand for?
Why can't the wise share their oil?
actions: Pray for the souls in purgatory
level2.prayer: Jesus, keep me ready for You. Amen.

activity.title: Is my lamp ready?
items: Say sorry for what I did wrong
Ask God to help me tomorrow

art.mainBrief: Five bridesmaids with bright lamps, five with dark ones
